# 卡片成组扇展

Component ID: shotcraft-card-stack

## Narrative intent

把八张真实图像由堆叠展开，让观众先感到数量，再看见内容差异。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Establish a collection of exactly eight real images or page slices; quantity first, diversity second.

Do not use:

- Not a layout for reading eight paragraphs, comparing precise values, or illustrating a feedback loop.

## Supported inputs

- title: Supply a short collection heading, at most 12 Chinese characters.
- mediaUrl: Existing project-local image: eight slices in a 4-column by 2-row contact sheet. Never use skeletons as delivered content.

## Reading order and motion

- Gather eight actual image slices into one stack
- Open the stack into a single three-dimensional fan

Pattern: progressive-build. Native default duration: 5.2s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### stack

- Target: .sc-card
- Visible action: Gather eight actual image slices into one stack
- Authored start: 0.65s; action duration: 2.24s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Gather eight actual image slices into one stack. Do not estimate from text length.

### fan

- Target: .sc-card
- Visible action: Open the stack into a single three-dimensional fan
- Authored start: 2.9s; action duration: 1.05s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Open the stack into a single three-dimensional fan. Do not estimate from text length.

These are authored event defaults, not measured speech alignment. Rebind active events to actual narration at project FPS; omitted capacity items must not acquire phantom cues. Preserve source easing, internal timing ratios and landing geometry. Source implementation is authoritative for curves not declared in the manifest; this card does not invent calibrated parameter ranges.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe. Do not shrink or truncate text.
- missingInput: Resolve required content and real assets; report a gap instead of using placeholder graphics.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured phrases while preserving original movement ratios and final hold. Split the scene if it does not fit.
- inapplicable: Select another proven recipe; with recipes-only policy, report the library gap rather than author custom graphics.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
